test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"cold."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Cold" **refers to a common viral infection that affects the upper respiratory system.
 
• Grammatically, **"cold" **is a noun and can be used as a subject, object, or complement in a sentence.
 
 
• Example: "I have a **cold **and can't come to work today."
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Plague: **a contagious bacterial disease that can be fatal (noun)
 
• **Bug: **an illness caused by a virus or bacteria (noun)
 
• **Complaint: **a statement expressing dissatisfaction or annoyance (noun)
